newsitem.title: PERU: Peru insists on release of all hostages together.
newsitem.headline: Peru insists on release of all hostages together.

text.p: The Peruvian government is insisting in talks with Marxist rebels that all 74 hostages they are holding be released together and at the same time, government negotiator Domingo Palermo said on Friday.
"My goal is to free the 74 hostages in their entirety, in good health and as quickly as possible in their entirety," Palermo told a group of foreign correspondents.
Palermo said he was the "contact, not the negotiator, though you could say it is the same thing."
He is in regular contact with both Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) leader Nestor Cerpa Cartolini and Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori.
He spoke with both Cerpa and Fujimori during a meeting lasting nearly three hours with correspondents from Reuters, the Italian news agency ANSA, Agence France Presse and Mexican TV company ECO.
It was his first contact with the press since the crisis began.
